rationale: The failure is a mismatch between frameless resizable HWND geometry and BrowserWindow bounds, including visible +16x8 outsets. BrowserWindow/BaseWindow is the direct surface. screen.dipToScreenRect measures coordinates; its conversion is not alleged to be broken. A gist is supplied. The reporter already lists #51244, whose getter inflation after changing resizable differs from the current stable getter/expanded HWND observation; do not repeat that link or promote other same-area geometry reports without a matching behavior.
